slot: iOS builds without owning a Mac

pick.name: Expo EAS Build + Submit
pick.what: Cloud macOS builds + App Store submission, manages certs/profiles
pick.why: Zero Mac needed and integrated with the Expo pick
pick.free_limits: Free: up to 15 iOS + 15 Android builds, low priority, 45-min timeout; Starter $19/mo incl. $45 build credit; Apple $99/yr extra
pick.install: npm i -g eas-cli && eas build -p ios

best_free.name: GitHub Actions macOS runners
best_free.why: Free for public repos; for private repos a small number of iOS builds fit in the included minutes
best_free.free_limits: Public repos: free on standard GitHub-hosted runners, including macOS. Private repos on GitHub Free: 2,000 included minutes/month; macOS is billed at $0.062/min and how it draws down included minutes is not stated on the billing page.

alts.name: Codemagic
alts.what: CI/CD with Mac mini M2 machines (Flutter, RN, native)
alts.why: 500 free macOS M2 build minutes/month; framework-agnostic
alts.free_limits: Free individual: 500 macOS M2 min/mo, 1 concurrent build; commercial use of free plan not stated

alts.name: Bitrise (Hobby)
alts.what: Mobile CI/CD with macOS machines; Hobby plan 300 credits/month, 1 private app
alts.free_limits: Hobby free: 300 credits/mo, 5 concurrency, 90-min timeout; described as for passion projects, commercial use not stated

candidates.name: Codemagic
candidates.verdict: Wins for Flutter/KMP or when EAS free builds run out.

candidates.name: Rent a cloud Mac (MacinCloud etc.)
candidates.verdict: Needed only for Xcode debugging; not checked.

candidates.name: Buy a used Mac mini
candidates.verdict: Best long-term if iOS becomes core.

decision: EAS Build is the pick because it pairs with Expo and needs no Mac on any OS. Codemagic (500 free macOS minutes) or GitHub Actions macOS runners are the fallbacks when free EAS builds run out.

verify.note: Free up to 15 iOS + 15 Android builds, low priority, 45-min timeout; Starter $19/mo with $45 credit. Reset period still not stated.
